{{Quote|We're drawing the enemy's attention&hellip; but we can't hold them off indefinitely.|[[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]], to [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]|<ref name="Obsession 4">[[Obsession 4|''Obsession'' 4]]</ref>}}
[[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] flew this green and dark gray '''Eta-2 ''Actis''-class interceptor''' during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]].

==History==
In this ship, Saesee Tiin led a squadron of fighters into [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] outer atmosphere, and landed in a docking bay of the heavily damaged [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]], the ''[[Impavid/Legends|Impavid]]''.
